<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex45042024-08-2914-22-289" status="finalized">de la snga ma dgag <abbr>pa'i</abbr> phyir | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3892">chos rje</rs> nyid kyi <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5564">rigs pa'i gter</rs> las |
               <quote source="db:5564"><l>la la brda dang tha snyad kyi |</l> 
               <l><abbr>grags</abbr> pa 2 su 'byed pa yod ||</l> 
               <l>tha snyad 'di yi skabs don min ||</l> 
               <l><abbr>mtshan nyid</abbr> de 'dra sngar bkag zin ||</l>
               <l>dngos dang zhen <abbr>pa'i</abbr> <choice><orig>rjod</orig><reg>brjod</reg></choice> rung gis ||</l> 
               <l>brda'i <abbr>grags</abbr> pa'ang 2 zhes zer || </l></quote></seg></TEI>
